title: SEARCHERS SWEEP IN WIDENING RINGS
why: His yes to suggestion 26, search patterns. A pillager or machine that lost you used to walk to one point near where it last saw you and, finding nothing there, give up the whole hunt on the spot. Now it searches in three widening rings: on reaching its point it picks a new one farther out along the same line and keeps looking, a good deal wider each time, and only gives up at the third. And you can see it: each searcher you can see paints a faint amber scan cone on the ground in front of it, wider and longer with each ring, sweeping a little from side to side. The cone is cut off by walls and by smoke, so smoke visibly breaks it, and it shortens to the distance past which crouching hides you from it while you crouch, which is exactly the distance at which crouching works. Player 2 sees the same cones. Nothing else about how they hunt changes.
now: Enemies that lose you now search in three widening rings and show an amber scan cone that smoke and crouching visibly cut short.
